The main takeaway from our work is that

3D molecular representations can be learned in an invariant way to chirality and conformational flexibility, enabling the use of 3D GIN models for molecular property prediction in the absence of multi-conformer data.
3D molecular representations can be learned with invariance to internal bond rotations, allowing for learning of chirality-sensitive functions without the need for expensive multi-conformer datasets.
SE(3)-equivariance and SE(3)- invariance to internal bond rotations are key for molecular chiral representation learning.
